gates.meaning: Two distinct side-rooted hair bundles form continuous tapered corkscrew helixes, each with multiple visually open turns.
pass_requires: two separate roots or continuous connection to the two sides of the head
both bundles show at least two readable successive helical turns
the helix shape narrows towards the tips and reads as hair

gates.meaning: A distinct silver ribbon strip winds around the exterior of each black spiral bundle on successive turns.
pass_requires: separate ribbon material or edges distinguish it from black hair
at least two successive wrapping crossings on each bundle
ribbon follows the same hair bundle and is not merely a root bow
confusions: a bow only at the root
ribbon hanging parallel beside the hair

gates.meaning: Sleeves are separate arm pieces with visible upper-arm skin gaps between them and the bodice.
pass_requires: both arm sleeves are readable as arm-worn clothing
both upper-arm gaps show uninterrupted skin separating sleeve tops from the bodice
sleeve volume continues towards each wrist
confusions: cold-shoulder cutout with remaining fabric bridge
hair or prop obscuring the join

gates.meaning: Thin raised coral cord-like lines follow dark navy garment seam or edge paths.
pass_requires: at least two continuous narrow coral edge or seam paths are visible
navy base cloth remains dominant beside the lines
line looks like an attached seam or edge trim rather than broad panel or free decorative motif
glass boundary separates room from visible exterior water and marine cues
right fingertips connect plausibly to right arm
finger contact on open page is observable at the reachable stand
skin, cloth, hair and glass show coherent photographic lighting and material behavior

reference_observation: Compare visible eye, nose, mouth and face-contour guidance descriptively; do not evaluate real identity, biometrics, actual age or body shape.
